I need to make several CSS adjustments: adding flex centering to the ghost and send buttons, incorporating top safe area spacing in the header, applying left/right safe areas to the main app container, creating a compact landscape layout, enabling scrolling for modal bodies on smaller screens, widening the app slightly on iPad, and updating the existing safe area bottom support to handle landscape cases too. The SVG inside the button can stay at 18px since the extra padding around it in the larger 44px button will look better. Looking back at the requirements, I should focus on testing the card stack view across mobile widths and iPad sizes, plus the recording functionality.

- `style.css` — touch targets raised to 44px (icon-btn, btn-ghost, btn-send); top/left/right safe-area insets added; landscape compact layout at `max-height: 500px`; iPad 768px+ widening to 540px; settings modal body scrollable with `max-height: 60vh`
